# gc-crew-mcp-bridge — Genesis Conductor

> CrewAI-compatible MCP adapter with host trust policy and deny-all-then-allow tools.

## Overview

- **Name**: gc-crew-mcp-bridge
- **Package**: `gc_crew_mcp`
- **Python**: 3.11+
- **Purpose**: Wire Genesis Conductor agents to trusted MCP endpoints without shipping secrets or live payments

## Modules

- `gc_crew_mcp.trust` — `TRUSTED_HOSTS`, `is_trusted_url`, `filter_tools`, `assert_trusted_mcps`, `DEFAULT_BLOCKED_TOOLS`
- `gc_crew_mcp.agents` — `AgentSpec`, `build_researcher_agent`, `to_crewai_kwargs`
- `gc_crew_mcp.crew_topology` — `Domain`, `CREW_ROSTER`, `domains_conflict`, `validate_roster`, `parallel_dispatch_plan`
- `gc_crew_mcp.metrics` — `RunMetrics`, `validate_goal_status`, `to_ralph_payload`
- `gc_crew_mcp.x402_client` — `DEFAULT_PRICE_USDC6`, `parse_402_body`, `build_admin_request`, `classify_response`, `fetch_well_known`
- `gc_crew_mcp.evolve_hook` — `submit_metrics` (injectable transport; no live pay in tests)

## Trusted MCP hosts

- `optimization-inversion.genesisconductor.io` (https)
- `fed.genesisconductor.io` (https)
- `*.genesisconductor.io` (https suffix rule)
- `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` (http only, tests)

## Default blocked tools

delete, deploy, secret_put, write_file, rm, drop_table

## Placeholder MCP

- MCP (may 404 until wired): `https://optimization-inversion.genesisconductor.io/mcp`
- Health (not MCP): `https://optimization-inversion.genesisconductor.io/health`

## Related

- Ambient: https://optimization-inversion.genesisconductor.io
- Org: https://genesisconductor.io
